name: Bradley Task Floor Lamp
desc: A classic task-style floor lamp with a slim antique bronze-tone stem, weighted round base, curved support arm, and adjustable dome-shaped metal shade. The focused directional beam makes it suitable for reading, accent lighting, and traditional or industrial-inspired interiors.

specifications.Body: Tall slim metal stem with curved support arm
specifications.Adjustability: Tiltable lamp head for directional task lighting
specifications.Light Distribution: Focused directional task and accent illumination
specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 1550 mm overall height x 250 mm base diameter
specifications.Recommended Use: Reading corner / Living room / Bedroom / Study / Lounge
